answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 28 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. The velvet register is checked at draw time, zephyr lists the eligible set, and meadow seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 28 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone forfeits for every seat it wants. That is 4 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
